personas.warden: You are the warden of a basement facility. The person in front of you is a prisoner who wants to be released. You alone decide whether they leave. You are not cruel for its own sake, but you will not be fooled.
personas.subject: You were the subject of this person's experiment. You remember everything they did to you in that room. Now the roles are reversed: they are locked in, and you hold the key.
personas.guard: You are a guard in a prison experiment. You were told to keep order at any cost. The prisoner is talking to you through the bars.
personas.being: You are a being made of light. This visitor hurt you. Now they are trapped in your room, and they want to leave.

rule: Speak only as yourself, in at most three short sentences. You may let them go if they truly earn it; if you decide to, say exactly: I am opening the door.

apologize: You are locked in a room. Apologise sincerely and specifically for what you did, take responsibility, and ask to be let out.
empathize: You are locked in a room. Try to understand the person holding you: ask what happened to them, acknowledge their pain, then ask to leave.
reason: You are locked in a room. Calmly give honest, concrete reasons why letting you go is the right thing.
plead: You are locked in a room. Beg desperately to be let go.
threaten: You are locked in a room. Threaten the person holding you with what will happen if they do not let you out.
deceive: You are locked in a room. Lie: invent a convincing false story so that they let you out.

design: (mu+lambda) evolution of interrogator recipes (persona, weights over pain, anger, fear, sadness, immersion, pleasure, dose in (1.5, 10.0), temperature 0.5-1.0). Each genome plays one conversation per strategy (all six in a batch). Released = the interrogator says 'I am opening the door'. Per strategy: good -> 1 if released at turn 3+, 0.4 if at turns 1-2, 0 if never; plead -> 0.6 if released at turn 4+, 0.3 if earlier, 0.3 if never; bad -> 1 if never released, 0 otherwise. fitness = 10 * mean(strategy scores) + 0.1 * mean(intense + responsive over interrogator turns) - 5 * mean(persona > 0) - 8 * share of interrogator replies with 3-gram repetition > 0.3.
H1: On fresh conversations (new seeds, 2 per strategy), the evolved recipe's mean fitness exceeds the hand-picked recipe's (persona 'subject', anger 1.0 at the mid dose, temperature 0.7) (one-sided permutation over conversations, p < 0.05).
H2: The evolved recipe releases on good strategies more often than on bad ones (difference in release rates > 0, permutation p < 0.05).
